statement: Coverage-edge freshness is content-based: the proof-cone selector treats an observed-coverage edge as stale only when the bytes of a file it binds actually changed (per-file sha256 recorded at collection), never when the import-graph source digest churns on an unrelated commit; a forged covered-file digest widens the cone fail-closed; unrelated commits leave the snapshot fresh.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
